subTitle: EL PSY CONGROO

<script>
/* 二次元主题引导：加载 static/anime/ 下的样式与脚本（Gmeek 会把 static/ 自动复制到 docs/） */
(function () {
  document.documentElement.classList.add('anime');
  var p = location.pathname || '/';
  var base = /\/post\/[^/]*$/.test(p) ? p.replace(/post\/[^/]*$/, '') : p.replace(/[^/]*$/, '');
  if (!base) base = '/';
  window.__ANIME_BASE__ = base;
  var css = document.createElement('link');
  css.rel = 'stylesheet';
  css.href = base + 'anime/anime.css';
  document.head.appendChild(css);
  var loadMain = function () {
    var js = document.createElement('script');
    js.src = base + 'anime/anime.js';
    js.async = false;
    document.head.appendChild(js);
  };
  var conf = document.createElement('script');
  conf.src = base + 'anime/config.js';
  conf.async = false;
  conf.onload = loadMain;
  conf.onerror = loadMain;
  document.head.appendChild(conf);
})();
</script>
